items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Porter Granger wrote, 'Michigan Water Tastes Like Sherry Wine.' I recorded that for him.

ctx.x: He worked with me. But he always tried to get Bessie to be a lady. Always. He always used to try to talk to Bessie. He'd take and tell Bessie, Bessie, don't be rough, don't be loud. Because he was such a gentleman. And he never got recognition for the things he did. Now, Porter Granger wrote, 'Michigan Water Tastes Like Sherry Wine.' I recorded that for him. Have you got that?
I have several recordings of that.
